messages.subject: Uploading .txt data and display it
parts:
Hi,


I would like to upload a .txt file, that contain only numbers that are put as in a matrix, and then display them.

For that job, i've made that code, but it doesn't run:

ui.R:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  hearderPanel("View of the matrix")
  sidebarPanel(
     fileInput('txt','Choose a file', accept=c('text/plain')
),
  tags$hr(),
  mainPanel(
    tableOutput('matrix')
)
))

server.R:

shintServer(function(input,output) {
  output$matrix <- renderTable({
    inFile <- input$txt
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    matrix <- read.table(file="inFile")
  })
})

The function read.table() is working on R, so I really don't understand...

Thanks!
